name: The Smart Fuel sensor is sent often enough and keeps its value while the estimate restarts
step: The Smart Fuel sensor is sent often enough and keeps its value while the estimate restarts
rationale:
Ethos showed the Smart Fuel telemetry sensor as lost as soon as the model was disarmed.
Two things in the suite made that happen. The same-value refresh of a DIY sensor waited
4.0 s, while Ethos wants a value at least every 4 s and the caller ticks every 0.5 s, so the
gap grew past 4 s. And after a disarm, when the pack voltage rises as the load goes away, the
estimator restarts and answers nil, which the session wrote to the sensor as a reset.

The harness drives the real sensor on the session's cadence and the real estimator through a
disarm with rising voltage. It checks that an unchanged value is pushed again within 2.5 s,
that the estimator says it is settling on every nil while it restarts, and that a missing
voltage is still a plain nil. The held value keeps being re-sent while the estimate settles,
and a battery config change clears it. A copy with the old 4.0 s window has to miss the bound.

Ported from rotorflight-lua-ethos-suite PR #2576.
